chapterInfo.content:
6
Wiasefoɔ anim asɛnnie
1Sɛ mo mu bi ne ne yɔnko nya asɛm a, ɔnsi ne bo nkɔ asɛnniiɛ wɔn a wɔntene anim, na ɛnyɛ ahotefoɔ anim anaa? 2#Adi 3.21; Dan 7.22 Monnim sɛ ahotefoɔ na wɔbɛbu wiase atɛn anaa? Na sɛ mo na mobɛbu wiase atɛn a, ɛmfata mo sɛ modi nsɛm nketewa anaa? 3Monnim sɛ yɛbɛbu abɔfoɔ atɛn? Na kampɛsɛ asetena yi mu nnoɔma? 4Na sɛ mowɔ asetena yi mu nnoɔma ho nsɛm a, wɔn a wɔmmu wɔn asafo no mu no na mode wɔn yɛ badwafoɔ? 5Meka yei mehyɛ mo aniwuo. Onyansafoɔ baako mpo nni mo mu a ɔbɛtumi abu onua ne onua ntam atɛn anaa? 6Adɛn na onua de onua kɔ asɛnniiɛ wɔn a wɔnnye nnie anim yi?
7 # Mat 5.39; 1 Te 5.15; 1 Pe 3.9 Mfomsoɔ anya aba mo mu sɛ mone mo ho mo ho wowɔ nsɛmnsɛm. Adɛn na mommma wɔnni mo amim mmom? Adɛn na mommma wɔnsisi mo mmom? 8Mo mmom na modi amim na mosisie, na mode yɛ anuanom mpo.
9Anaasɛ monnim sɛ wɔn a wɔntene no rennya Nyankopɔn ahennie no? Mommma wɔnnnaadaa mo: Adwamammɔfoɔ, abosonsomfoɔ, awaresɛefoɔ, mmarima ahohwifoɔ, mmarima a wɔne mmarima da, 10#Gal 5.19-21 awifoɔ, aniberefoɔ, asabofoɔ, ntɔkwapɛfoɔ ne amimfoɔ rennya Nyankopɔn ahennie no. 11#Tito 3.3-7 Saa na anka mo mu bi teɛ; na afei wɔadware mo, na wɔate mo ho, na wɔabu mo bem Awurade Yesu Kristo din ne yɛn Nyankopɔn honhom mu.
Fa wo nipadua hyɛ Onyankopɔn animuonyam
12 # 1 Ko 10.23 Mewɔ nnoɔma nyinaa ho kwan, nanso ɛnyɛ ne nyinaa na ɛyɛ; mewɔ nnoɔma nyinaa ho kwan, nanso memma biribiara nhyɛ me so. 13#1 Te 4.3-5 Aduane yɛ yafunu dea, na yafunu nso yɛ aduane dea; na Onyankopɔn bɛma ne mmienu ayɛ kwa. Na nipadua nyɛ adwamammɔ dea, na ɛyɛ Awurade dea, na Awurade yɛ nipadua dea. 14#1 Ko 15.15; 15.20; 2 Ko 4.14 Na Onyankopɔn anyane Awurade, na ɔnam ne tumi so bɛnyane yɛn bi.
15 # 1 Ko 12.27 Monnim sɛ mo nipadua yɛ Kristo akwaa bi? Memfa Kristo akwaa menkɔyɛ no odwamamfoɔ akwaa? Ɛmpare me! 16#Gye 2.24 Anaasɛ monnim sɛ deɛ ɔde ne ho bɔ odwamamfoɔ ho no, na ɔne no ayɛ nipadua baako anaa? Ɛfiri sɛ ɔka sɛ: Wɔn baanu bɛyɛ honam baako. 17#Yoh 17.21-22; Efe 5.30 Na deɛ ɔde ne ho bɔ Awurade ho no ne no yɛ honhom baako. 18Monnwane adwamammɔ! Bɔne biara a onipa yɛ nni nipadua mu, na deɛ ɔbɔ adwaman no deɛ, ɔyɛ ɔno ara ne nipadua bɔne. 19#1 Ko 3.16 Anaasɛ monnim sɛ mo nipadua yɛ Honhom Kronkron a ɔwɔ mo mu, a monya firii Nyankopɔn hɔ no asɔredan, na monne mo ho? 20#1 Ko 7.23; 1 Pe 1.18-19; Flp 1.20 Na wɔtɔɔ mo aboɔden; enti monhyɛ Onyankopɔn animuonyam mo nipadua mu.

pageProps.chapterText:
Sɛ mo mu bi ne ne yɔnko nya asɛm a, ɔnsi ne bo nkɔ asɛnniiɛ wɔn a wɔntene anim, na ɛnyɛ ahotefoɔ anim anaa? Monnim sɛ ahotefoɔ na wɔbɛbu wiase atɛn anaa? Na sɛ mo na mobɛbu wiase atɛn a, ɛmfata mo sɛ modi nsɛm nketewa anaa? Monnim sɛ yɛbɛbu abɔfoɔ atɛn? Na kampɛsɛ asetena yi mu nnoɔma? Na sɛ mowɔ asetena yi mu nnoɔma ho nsɛm a, wɔn a wɔmmu wɔn asafo no mu no na mode wɔn yɛ badwafoɔ? Meka yei mehyɛ mo aniwuo. Onyansafoɔ baako mpo nni mo mu a ɔbɛtumi abu onua ne onua ntam atɛn anaa? Adɛn na onua de onua kɔ asɛnniiɛ wɔn a wɔnnye nnie anim yi?
Mfomsoɔ anya aba mo mu sɛ mone mo ho mo ho wowɔ nsɛmnsɛm. Adɛn na mommma wɔnni mo amim mmom? Adɛn na mommma wɔnsisi mo mmom? Mo mmom na modi amim na mosisie, na mode yɛ anuanom mpo.
Anaasɛ monnim sɛ wɔn a wɔntene no rennya Nyankopɔn ahennie no? Mommma wɔnnnaadaa mo: Adwamammɔfoɔ, abosonsomfoɔ, awaresɛefoɔ, mmarima ahohwifoɔ, mmarima a wɔne mmarima da, awifoɔ, aniberefoɔ, asabofoɔ, ntɔkwapɛfoɔ ne amimfoɔ rennya Nyankopɔn ahennie no. Saa na anka mo mu bi teɛ; na afei wɔadware mo, na wɔate mo ho, na wɔabu mo bem Awurade Yesu Kristo din ne yɛn Nyankopɔn honhom mu.

Mewɔ nnoɔma nyinaa ho kwan, nanso ɛnyɛ ne nyinaa na ɛyɛ; mewɔ nnoɔma nyinaa ho kwan, nanso memma biribiara nhyɛ me so. Aduane yɛ yafunu dea, na yafunu nso yɛ aduane dea; na Onyankopɔn bɛma ne mmienu ayɛ kwa. Na nipadua nyɛ adwamammɔ dea, na ɛyɛ Awurade dea, na Awurade yɛ nipadua dea. Na Onyankopɔn anyane Awurade, na ɔnam ne tumi so bɛnyane yɛn bi.
Monnim sɛ mo nipadua yɛ Kristo akwaa bi? Memfa Kristo akwaa menkɔyɛ no odwamamfoɔ akwaa? Ɛmpare me! Anaasɛ monnim sɛ deɛ ɔde ne ho bɔ odwamamfoɔ ho no, na ɔne no ayɛ nipadua baako anaa? Ɛfiri sɛ ɔka sɛ: Wɔn baanu bɛyɛ honam baako. Na deɛ ɔde ne ho bɔ Awurade ho no ne no yɛ honhom baako. Monnwane adwamammɔ! Bɔne biara a onipa yɛ nni nipadua mu, na deɛ ɔbɔ adwaman no deɛ, ɔyɛ ɔno ara ne nipadua bɔne. Anaasɛ monnim sɛ mo nipadua yɛ Honhom Kronkron a ɔwɔ mo mu, a monya firii Nyankopɔn hɔ no asɔredan, na monne mo ho? Na wɔtɔɔ mo aboɔden; enti monhyɛ Onyankopɔn animuonyam mo nipadua mu.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
